description: Flashscore match list for one sport and day (7 days back to 7 ahead): every match with Flashscore ID, competition (country: league), start time, home/away team, current or final score and state (scheduled, live with period, finished, after extra time/penalties, postponed, cancelled). Football, tennis, basketball, hockey, American football, baseball, handball, volleyball. Read from the feed the Flashscore web page loads. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
